Opened by reporting-dev-ngo on 2026-11-06

Adding a 21st recipient to a scheduled export with `PATCH /reports/:id` gives
`validation failed`, and so does a report name over 120 characters or a list of
more than 50 categories. None of

args.title: Document limits on report fields in the API reference
args.body:
File: docs/api-reference.md

Add explicit details about limits on fields for report creation and update.

Include the maximum length of report names (120 characters), the maximum number of recipients (20), and the maximum number of categories (50) allowed by the API. This documentation will help users understand validation constraints to avoid errors when using PATCH /reports/:id.
